description: This file defines the SeatBillingStrategyFactory class responsible for creating different seat billing strategies based on team or subscription data, including dependencies and logic for feature toggles and fallback strategies.

classes.name: SeatBillingStrategyFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating seat billing strategies based on team or subscription info, with dependency injection and feature toggle logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the factory with dependencies and sets up different billing strategies and fallback.

methods.name: createByTeamId
methods.description: Creates a billing strategy based on team ID, considering billing mode, period, and feature flags.

methods.name: createBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a billing strategy based on subscription ID, retrieving team info and falling back if not found.
